intro.text: An older woman at the Diem who interrupts Lord Mastrell Kenton to ask about a shipment of zaidon.

items.text: Doril was one of several people who broke in on Kenton with everyday questions, hers about when the next zaidon would arrive, which led Khriss to suggest he hand some of his duties to Elorin and Dirin.

appearance.text: Grey-haired, wearing an apron over her robes.
